name: isRulestackCommitClean
definition: True when the policy the firewall tool reads has no uncommitted (candidate) changes, so the policy the firewall enforces equals the last committed configuration.
population: the policy sets (candidate configuration or rulestacks) in use by the firewalls the credential reaches; unused ones are ignored
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, successful read showing no pending changes for every policy set in use; an error, empty or possibly cut-off read is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Answers only a tool that has a commit step between candidate and running policy. Hardware firewalls use the pending-changes check; cloud rulestacks use the uncommitted list.
